\label{lemma-p-ring-map}
Let $\varphi : R \to S$ be a ring map. If
\begin{enumerate}
\item for any $x \in S$ there exists $n > 0$ such that
$x^n$ is in the image of $\varphi$, and
\item for any $x \in \Ker(\varphi)$ there exists $n > 0$
